functions.name: audit_metadata_has_sensitive_key
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_metadata_has_sensitive_key(value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
         WITH RECURSIVE nodes(value) AS (
           SELECT $1
           UNION ALL
           SELECT child.value
           FROM nodes AS parent
           CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT object_entry.value
             FROM jsonb_each(
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(parent.value) = 'object' THEN parent.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
             ) AS object_entry
             UNION ALL
             SELECT array_entry.value
             FROM jsonb_array_elements(
               CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(parent.value) = 'array' THEN parent.value ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
             ) AS array_entry
           ) AS child
         ), keys AS (
           SELECT lower(object_key.name) AS name
           FROM nodes
           CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(
             CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(nodes.value) = 'object' THEN nodes.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
           ) AS object_key(name)
         )
         SELECT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM keys
           WHERE name = ANY (ARRAY[
             'pesel', 'nip', 'regon', 'sms', 'smscode', 'sms_code', 'password', 'cookie', 'set-cookie',
             'token', 'access_token', 'refresh_token', 'secret', 'authorization', 'credential', 'credentials',
             'firstname', 'lastname', 'fullname', 'name', 'address', 'phone', 'email'
           ]::text[])
         )
       $function$

functions.name: goldis_populate_run_input_snapshot
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.goldis_populate_run_input_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
       BEGIN
         IF NEW.input_snapshot IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.input_snapshot) <> 'object'
           OR COALESCE(NEW.input_snapshot->>'schemaVersion', '') NOT IN ('1', '2')
           OR COALESCE(NEW.input_snapshot->>'sourceRowId', '') <> NEW.source_row_id::text THEN
           SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'schemaVersion', 1, 'sourceRowId', source.id, 'rowNumber', source.row_number,
             'rowVersion', source.row_version, 'companyName', source.company_name,
             'decisionMakerName', source.decision_maker_name, 'nipRaw', source.nip_raw,
             'address', source.address, 'postalCode', source.postal_code, 'city', source.city,
             'countyCode', source.county_code, 'regonRaw', source.regon_raw, 'regon', source.regon,
             'effectiveRegon', source.effective_regon, 'issues', source.issues
           ) INTO NEW.input_snapshot FROM source_rows source WHERE source.id = NEW.source_row_id;
           IF NEW.input_snapshot IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUN_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
         END IF;
         RETURN NEW;
       END;
       $function$
